<summary>Tool use: **run_terminal_command_v2** • Run command: python3 &lt;&lt; &#39;PY&#39;
import re, json
from pathlib import Path

# Load scripture to get max verse per chapter
db = json.loads(Path(&#34;data/scripture-nasb1995.json&#34;).read_text())
chapter_max = {}
for ref in db.get(&#34;verses&#34;, {}):
    m = re.match(r&#34;^(.+?) (\d+):(\d+)$&#34;, ref)
    if m:
        book, ch, v = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
        key = f&#34;{book} {ch}&#34;
        chapter_max[key] = max(chapter_max.get(key, 0), v)

notes = Path(&#34;content/english/notes&#34;)
violations = []
for f in sorted(notes.glob(&#34;*.md&#34;)):
    text = f.read_text()
    for m in re.finditer(r&#39;bible ref=&#34;([^&#34;]+)&#34;&#39;, text):
        ref = m.group(1)
        parts = ref.rsplit(&#34; &#34;, 1)
        if len(parts) != 2:
            continue
        book, loc = parts
        if &#34;-&#34; in loc:
            left, right = loc.split(&#34;-&#34;, 1)
            if &#34;:&#34; in left:
                ch, vstart = left.split(&#34;:&#34;, 1)
                vstart = int(vstart)
                vend = int(right.split(&#34;:&#34;)[-1]) if &#34;:&#34; in right else int(right)
                key = f&#34;{book} {ch}&#34;
                maxv = chapter_max.get(key)
                if maxv and vstart == 1 and vend &gt;= maxv:
                    violations.append((f.name, ref, maxv, &#34;full_chapter&#34;))
                elif vend - vstart + 1 &gt; 12:
                    violations.append((f.name, ref, maxv, f&#34;long_span_{vend-vstart+1}&#34;))
        elif &#34;:&#34; in loc:
            ch, v = loc.split(&#34;:&#34;, 1)
            # single verse OK
            pass

print(&#34;FULL CHAPTER:&#34;)
for v in violations:
    if v[3] == &#34;full_chapter&#34;:
        print(f&#34;  {v[0]}: {v[1]} (chapter has {v[2]} verses)&#34;)

print(&#34;\nLONG SPANS (&gt;12 verses):&#34;)
for v in violations:

```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import re, json
from pathlib import Path

# Load scripture to get max verse per chapter
db = json.loads(Path("data/scripture-nasb1995.json").read_text())
chapter_max = {}
for ref in db.get("verses", {}):
    m = re.match(r"^(.+?) (\d+):(\d+)$", ref)
    if m:
        book, ch, v = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
        key = f"{book} {ch}"
        chapter_max[key] = max(chapter_max.get(key, 0), v)

notes = Path("content/english/notes")
violations = []
for f in sorted(notes.glob("*.md")):
    text = f.read_text()
    for m in re.finditer(r'bible ref="([^"]+)"', text):
        ref = m.group(1)
        parts = ref.rsplit(" ", 1)
        if len(parts) != 2:
            continue
        book, loc = parts
        if "-" in loc:
            left, right = loc.split("-", 1)
            if ":" in left:
                ch, vstart = left.split(":", 1)
                vstart = int(vstart)
                vend = int(right.split(":")[-1]) if ":" in right else int(right)
                key = f"{book} {ch}"
                maxv = chapter_max.get(key)
                if maxv and vstart == 1 and vend >= maxv:
                    violations.append((f.name, ref, maxv, "full_chapter"))
                elif vend - vstart + 1 > 12:
                    violations.append((f.name, ref, maxv, f"long_span_{vend-vstart+1}"))
        elif ":" in loc:
            ch, v = loc.split(":", 1)
            # single verse OK
            pass

print("FULL CHAPTER:")
for v in violations:
    if v[3] == "full_chapter":
        print(f"  {v[0]}: {v[1]} (chapter has {v[2]} verses)")

print("\nLONG SPANS (>12 verses):")
for v in violations:
    if v[3].startswith("long_span"):
        print(f"  {v[0]}: {v[1]} ({v[3]})")
PY
```
